items.title: In the Studio With Rama Duwaji
items.summary: 德州出生的叙利亚裔美国艺术家Rama Duwaji在工作室受访,谈插画、动画、油画与陶艺创作。她因丈夫当选纽约市长成为纽约“第一夫人”,讲述辗转德州、迪拜、卡塔尔等地的成长如何塑造其艺术视角,并表示将继续以责任感投入创作。
items.title_zh: 在工作室与Rama Duwaji对话
items.title_en: In the Studio With Rama Duwaji
items.summary_zh: 德州出生的叙利亚裔美国艺术家Rama Duwaji在工作室受访，谈插画、动画、油画与陶艺创作。她因丈夫当选纽约市长成为纽约“第一夫人”，讲述辗转德州、迪拜、卡塔尔等地的成长如何塑造其艺术视角，并表示将继续以责任感投入创作。
items.summary_en: Texas-born Syrian-American artist Rama Duwaji discusses her work in illustration, animation, oil painting, and ceramics in a studio interview. As New York's 'First Lady' following her husband's election as mayor, she recounts how growing up across Texas, Dubai, and Qatar shaped her artistic perspective, and expresses her commitment to creating with a sense of responsibility.

items.title: Beer With a Painter: Tom Burckhardt
items.summary: 抽象画家Tom Burckhardt在纽约东村与陶艺家妻子Kathy Butterly共用的工作室接受“与画家喝一杯”专访。他1964年生于艺术家家庭,成长于纽约画派传统中,访谈谈及以怀疑与幽默对抗归类,作品横跨抽象绘画、装置与旧书页拼贴。
items.title_zh: 与画家喝一杯：Tom Burckhardt
items.title_en: Beer With a Painter: Tom Burckhardt
items.summary_zh: 抽象画家Tom Burckhardt在纽约东村与陶艺家妻子Kathy Butterly共用的工作室接受“与画家喝一杯”专访。他1964年生于艺术家家庭，成长于纽约画派传统中，访谈谈及以怀疑与幽默对抗归类，作品横跨抽象绘画、装置与旧书页拼贴。
items.summary_en: Abstract painter Tom Burckhardt is interviewed for 'Beer With a Painter' in his shared studio in New York's East Village with his wife, ceramicist Kathy Butterly. Born in 1964 into an artistic family and raised in the New York School tradition, he discusses using skepticism and humor to resist categorization, with a practice spanning abstract painting, installation, and collage on old book pages.

items.title: 李明谈最新个展“Swayy Wayy”
items.summary: 艺术家李明就其在香港天线空间的个展“Swayy Wayy”(展至8月8日)接受采访。他谈及如何通过剪辑将密集素材转化为雕塑般的影像,视剪辑为“打碎线性的时间”,介绍自2017年起的“烟士披里纯”系列及对AI的探索,并回顾二十年影像创作。
items.title_zh: 李明谈最新个展“Swayy Wayy”
items.title_en: Li Ming on His Latest Solo Exhibition 'Swayy Wayy'
items.summary_zh: 艺术家李明就其在香港天线空间的个展“Swayy Wayy”（展至8月8日）接受采访。他谈及如何通过剪辑将密集素材转化为雕塑般的影像，视剪辑为“打碎线性的时间”，介绍自2017年起的“烟士披里纯”系列及对AI的探索，并回顾二十年影像创作。
items.summary_en: Artist Li Ming is interviewed about his solo exhibition 'Swayy Wayy' at Antenna Space in Hong Kong (through August 8). He discusses how editing transforms dense material into sculptural video, viewing editing as 'shattering linear time,' introduces the 'Inspiration' series begun in 2017 and his exploration of AI, and reflects on two decades of video creation.

items.id: news-117hd5-程新皓谈-如此-我们将毫无阻碍地穿越他们的群山
items.title: 程新皓谈“如此,我们将毫无阻碍地穿越他们的群山”
items.summary: 艺术家程新皓就北京个展接受采访,谈及以踢石头等缓慢身体动作为方法,考察云南如何被历代交通系统塑造。主要作品《层积与漂砾》(2023-2024)记录从昆明到瑞丽沿滇缅公路的行走,呈现多重路网叠合的历史层理与身体感知。
items.title_zh: 程新皓谈“如此，我们将毫无阻碍地穿越他们的群山”
items.title_en: Cheng Xinhao on 'Thus We Shall Pass Through Their Mountains Without Obstruction'
items.summary_zh: 艺术家程新皓就北京个展接受采访，谈及以踢石头等缓慢身体动作为方法，考察云南如何被历代交通系统塑造。主要作品《层积与漂砾》（2023-2024）记录从昆明到瑞丽沿滇缅公路的行走，呈现多重路网叠合的历史层理与身体感知。
items.summary_en: Artist Cheng Xinhao is interviewed about his Beijing solo exhibition, discussing how slow bodily actions like kicking stones serve as a method to examine how Yunnan has been shaped by successive transportation systems. The main work 'Stratification and Erratic Boulders' (2023-2024) documents a walk from Kunming to Ruili along the Burma Road, revealing historical layers of overlapping road networks and bodily perception.

items.title: Chloe Wise: 'I'm trying to put all of these things into a mishmash soup'
items.summary: 加拿大艺术家Chloe Wise谈其在巴塞尔H. Geiger文化基金会的首个瑞士机构个展“Extrasensory”。展览从她标志性的具象绘画转向多频影像与沉浸式装置,探讨超感官知觉。她融合科幻、宗教、消费品与艺术史等参照,并称指挥70人团队如同“用人来作画”。
items.title_zh: Chloe Wise：“我试图把所有这些东西放进一锅乱炖汤里”
items.title_en: Chloe Wise: 'I'm trying to put all of these things into a mishmash soup'
items.summary_zh: 加拿大艺术家Chloe Wise谈其在巴塞尔H. Geiger文化基金会的首个瑞士机构个展“Extrasensory”。展览从她标志性的具象绘画转向多频影像与沉浸式装置，探讨超感官知觉。她融合科幻、宗教、消费品与艺术史等参照，并称指挥70人团队如同“用人来作画”。
items.summary_en: Canadian artist Chloe Wise discusses her first Swiss institutional solo exhibition 'Extrasensory' at the H. Geiger Cultural Foundation in Basel. The show shifts from her signature figurative painting to multi-channel video and immersive installations exploring extrasensory perception. She blends references from sci-fi, religion, consumer goods, and art history, and describes directing a 70-person team as 'painting with people.'

items.id: news-1vhcde-普利茅斯-the-box-博物馆荣获2026英国艺术基金-年度博物馆-大奖
items.title: 普利茅斯 The Box 博物馆荣获2026英国艺术基金"年度博物馆"大奖
items.summary: 英国普利茅斯的 The Box 博物馆荣获2026年度英国艺术基金"年度博物馆"大奖，奖金12万英镑，为全球最高额博物馆奖项。评委称赞其与本地社区深度互动、重新构想历史藏品叙事，五年间已覆盖全市89%的学校。其余四家入围机构各获2万英镑。
items.title_zh: 普利茅斯 The Box 博物馆荣获2026英国艺术基金“年度博物馆”大奖
items.title_en: Plymouth's The Box Museum Wins 2026 Art Fund Museum of the Year Award
items.summary_zh: 英国普利茅斯的 The Box 博物馆荣获2026年度英国艺术基金“年度博物馆”大奖，奖金12万英镑，为全球最高额博物馆奖项。评委称赞其与本地社区深度互动、重新构想历史藏品叙事，五年间已覆盖全市89%的学校。其余四家入围机构各获2万英镑。
items.summary_en: The Box museum in Plymouth, UK, has won the 2026 Art Fund Museum of the Year award, with a £120,000 prize, the largest museum award globally. Judges praised its deep engagement with the local community and reimagined narratives of historical collections, reaching 89% of schools in the city over five years. The other four finalists each received £20,000.

items.id: news-1k3vge-泰特英国美术馆公布2026年特纳奖入围名单
items.title: 泰特英国美术馆公布2026年特纳奖入围名单
items.summary: 泰特英国美术馆公布2026年特纳奖四位入围艺术家：Simeon Barclay、Kira Freije、Marguerite Humeau 与 Tanoa Sasraku。作品展将于9月26日至次年3月29日在米德尔斯堡当代艺术学院（MIMA）举办，获奖者12月10日揭晓，奖金2.5万英镑，其余入围者各获1万英镑。
items.title_zh: 泰特英国美术馆公布2026年特纳奖入围名单
items.title_en: Tate Britain Announces Shortlist for 2026 Turner Prize
items.summary_zh: 泰特英国美术馆公布2026年特纳奖四位入围艺术家：Simeon Barclay、Kira Freije、Marguerite Humeau 与 Tanoa Sasraku。作品展将于9月26日至次年3月29日在米德尔斯堡当代艺术学院（MIMA）举办，获奖者12月10日揭晓，奖金2.5万英镑，其余入围者各获1万英镑。
items.summary_en: Tate Britain has announced the four artists shortlisted for the 2026 Turner Prize: Simeon Barclay, Kira Freije, Marguerite Humeau, and Tanoa Sasraku. The exhibition of their work will be held at the Middlesbrough Institute of Modern Art (MIMA) from September 26 to March 29 the following year. The winner will be announced on December 10, receiving £25,000, while the other shortlisted artists will each receive £10,000.

items.title: 中国美术馆2026暑期夜场开放 每日新增预约名额2000个
items.summary: 中国美术馆为满足暑期观众需求开放夜场，2026年7月15日至8月30日实行延时开放：工作日17时停止入馆、18时闭馆，周六日19时停止入馆、20时闭馆。馆方每日新增2000个预约参观名额，实行分时段错峰入场，观众需通过官方微信小程序提前线上预约。

items.title_en: National Art Museum of China Opens Summer Evening Sessions in 2026, Adds 2,000 Daily Reservations
items.summary_zh: 中国美术馆为满足暑期观众需求开放夜场，2026年7月15日至8月30日实行延时开放：工作日17时停止入馆、18时闭馆，周六日19时停止入馆、20时闭馆。馆方每日新增2000个预约参观名额，实行分时段错峰入场，观众需通过官方微信小程序提前线上预约。
items.summary_en: To meet the demand of summer visitors, the National Art Museum of China will open evening sessions from July 15 to August 30, 2026, with extended hours: last entry at 5 PM and closing at 6 PM on weekdays, and last entry at 7 PM and closing at 8 PM on weekends. The museum adds 2,000 daily reservation slots, with timed entry to stagger crowds. Visitors must make online reservations in advance through the official WeChat mini-program.

items.id: news-8qxbz8-马西米利亚诺-焦尼被任命为纽约新美术馆馆长
items.title: 马西米利亚诺·焦尼被任命为纽约新美术馆馆长
items.summary: 纽约新美术馆宣布任命任职12年的艺术总监马西米利亚诺·焦尼为新任馆长，接替执掌该馆26年、去年9月宣布退休的丽莎·菲利普斯。焦尼2009年共同创立新美术馆三年展，2013年成为威尼斯双年展最年轻策展人，将于8月1日正式上任。
items.title_zh: 马西米利亚诺·焦尼被任命为纽约新美术馆馆长
items.title_en: Massimiliano Gioni Appointed Director of the New Museum in New York
items.summary_zh: 纽约新美术馆宣布任命任职12年的艺术总监马西米利亚诺·焦尼为新任馆长，接替执掌该馆26年、去年9月宣布退休的丽莎·菲利普斯。焦尼2009年共同创立新美术馆三年展，2013年成为威尼斯双年展最年轻策展人，将于8月1日正式上任。
items.summary_en: The New Museum in New York has announced the appointment of Massimiliano Gioni, its artistic director of 12 years, as the new director, succeeding Lisa Phillips, who led the museum for 26 years and announced her retirement last September. Gioni co-founded the New Museum Triennial in 2009 and became the youngest curator of the Venice Biennale in 2013. He will officially assume the role on August 1.

items.title: 2026威尼斯双年展取消金狮奖 改设访客投票"访客狮"
items.summary: 威尼斯双年展组织方宣布，2026年将取消传统的最佳艺术家金狮奖和最佳国家馆银狮奖，改由现场访客投票选出"访客狮"奖得主。颁奖时间也从5月9日开幕日推迟至11月22日闭幕日。俄罗斯和以色列此次获准参与竞争。
items.title_zh: 2026威尼斯双年展取消金狮奖 改设访客投票"访客狮"
items.title_en: 2026 Venice Biennale Abolishes Golden Lion, Introduces Visitor-Voted "Visitor Lion"
items.summary_zh: 威尼斯双年展组织方宣布，2026年将取消传统的最佳艺术家金狮奖和最佳国家馆银狮奖，改由现场访客投票选出"访客狮"奖得主。颁奖时间也从5月9日开幕日推迟至11月22日闭幕日。俄罗斯和以色列此次获准参与竞争。
items.summary_en: The organizers of the Venice Biennale have announced that in 2026, the traditional Golden Lion for best artist and Silver Lion for best national pavilion will be abolished, replaced by a "Visitor Lion" award voted on by on-site visitors. The award ceremony will also be postponed from the opening day on May 9 to the closing day on November 22. Russia and Israel are permitted to compete this time.

items.title: Vital Acts: On the Public Work of Criticism
items.summary: Artforum 2026年5月刊主编寄语,由Daniel Wenger与Rachel Wetzler合写。文章将"批评是否重要"重构为"批评能告诉我们关于世界的什么",提出"艺术即形式""艺术大于艺术""艺术揭示谎言"三个命题,以"MONUMENTS"退役邦联雕像展等为例,强调批评是维系公共领域之为公共的行动。
items.title_zh: Vital Acts: On the Public Work of Criticism
items.title_en: Vital Acts: On the Public Work of Criticism
items.summary_zh: Artforum 2026年5月刊主编寄语,由Daniel Wenger与Rachel Wetzler合写。文章将"批评是否重要"重构为"批评能告诉我们关于世界的什么",提出"艺术即形式""艺术大于艺术""艺术揭示谎言"三个命题,以"MONUMENTS"退役邦联雕像展等为例,强调批评是维系公共领域之为公共的行动。
items.summary_en: Editor's note for the May 2026 issue of Artforum, co-written by Daniel Wenger and Rachel Wetzler. The article reframes "Does criticism matter?" as "What can criticism tell us about the world?", proposing three propositions: "art as form," "art beyond art," and "art reveals lies." Using the "MONUMENTS" exhibition of retired Confederate statues as an example, it emphasizes that criticism is an act that sustains the public sphere as public.

items.title: The Polycrisis Sublime of the Whitney Biennial
items.summary: Aruna D'Souza评论2026年惠特尼双年展(策展人Marcela Guerrero与Drew Sawyer)。本届未设强主题,以"关系与基础设施、纠缠与亲缘"为线索,纳入阿富汗、智利、伊拉克、冲绳、菲律宾、波多黎各、越南等受美国影响地区的56组艺术家,涉及监控、殖民、哀悼与环境议题,政治意涵流经艺术表达而非直接给出答案。

items.title_en: The Polycrisis Sublime of the Whitney Biennial

items.summary_en: Aruna D'Souza reviews the 2026 Whitney Biennial (curated by Marcela Guerrero and Drew Sawyer). This edition has no strong theme, using "relations and infrastructure, entanglement and kinship" as threads, including 56 artists from regions affected by the US such as Afghanistan, Chile, Iraq, Okinawa, the Philippines, Puerto Rico, and Vietnam, addressing issues of surveillance, colonialism, mourning, and the environment. Political implications flow through artistic expression rather than providing direct answers.

items.id: news-1an3gg-后真相时代-艺术之-韧-何为-30个年度当代艺术与建筑展在中国-taj-review-2025
items.title: 后真相时代,艺术之"韧"何为?30个年度当代艺术与建筑展在中国｜TAJ Review 2025
items.summary: 《艺术新闻》年度回顾,以"韧"为年度字,分析2025年大中华区展览生态。文章认为在AI生成低质内容(slop)泛滥、信息真假难辨的后真相时代,策展与创作展现出抗压与讲述故事的能力,精选30场展览,涵盖大馆当代美术馆、西岸美术馆、M+等机构,涉及杨福东、刘小东、林天苗等艺术家。
items.title_zh: 后真相时代，艺术之"韧"何为？30个年度当代艺术与建筑展在中国｜TAJ Review 2025
items.title_en: In the Post-Truth Era, What is Art's "Resilience"? 30 Annual Contemporary Art and Architecture Exhibitions in China | TAJ Review 2025
items.summary_zh: 《艺术新闻》年度回顾，以"韧"为年度字，分析2025年大中华区展览生态。文章认为在AI生成低质内容(slop)泛滥、信息真假难辨的后真相时代，策展与创作展现出抗压与讲述故事的能力，精选30场展览，涵盖大馆当代美术馆、西岸美术馆、M+等机构，涉及杨福东、刘小东、林天苗等艺术家。
items.summary_en: The Art Newspaper's annual review takes "resilience" as the word of the year, analyzing the exhibition ecosystem in Greater China in 2025. The article argues that in the post-truth era of AI-generated slop and indistinguishable truth from falsehood, curation and creation demonstrate the ability to withstand pressure and tell stories. It selects 30 exhibitions, covering institutions such as Tai Kwun Contemporary, West Bund Museum, and M+, featuring artists like Yang Fudong, Liu Xiaodong, and Lin Tianmiao.

items.title: An Exhibition of Silenced Artists Sends a Warning in New York City
items.summary: Isa Farfan报道纽约下曼哈顿Nathalie Karg画廊的展览《Don't Look Now: A Defense of Free Expression》,由Art at a Time Like This与策展人Barbara Pollack组织。展览陈列因DEI打压、反巴勒斯坦言论限制与经费削减而被撤展、审查的艺术家作品,包括Danielle SeeWalker、Andil Gosine等,主张艺术自由是民主健康的"矿井金丝雀"。
items.title_zh: 一场被沉默艺术家的展览在纽约发出警告
items.title_en: An Exhibition of Silenced Artists Sends a Warning in New York City
items.summary_zh: Isa Farfan报道纽约下曼哈顿Nathalie Karg画廊的展览《Don't Look Now: A Defense of Free Expression》，由Art at a Time Like This与策展人Barbara Pollack组织。展览陈列因DEI打压、反巴勒斯坦言论限制与经费削减而被撤展、审查的艺术家作品，包括Danielle SeeWalker、Andil Gosine等，主张艺术自由是民主健康的"矿井金丝雀"。
items.summary_en: Isa Farfan reports on the exhibition "Don't Look Now: A Defense of Free Expression" at Nathalie Karg Gallery in Lower Manhattan, organized by Art at a Time Like This and curator Barbara Pollack. The exhibition features works by artists who have been de-installed or censored due to DEI crackdowns, restrictions on pro-Palestinian speech, and funding cuts, including Danielle SeeWalker and Andil Gosine, arguing that artistic freedom is a "canary in the coal mine" for democratic health.

items.id: news-1fjf57-一周展讯-暑假推荐看这些大展
items.title: 一周展讯｜暑假推荐看这些大展

items.summary_en: A weekly exhibition guide compiled by The Paper reporter Liang Jia, recommending major exhibitions across China during summer vacation: "Giorgio Morandi: Monologue" at the Museum of Art Pudong, Shanghai; "Qin: The Road to Unification" archaeological special exhibition at the Shanghai Museum East; a dual solo exhibition of Sheila Hicks and Shi Hui at the West Bund Museum; a solo exhibition of Brazilian painter Portinari at the National Museum of China; and an exhibition of new archaeological discoveries of Yuan blue-and-white porcelain at the Nanjing City Wall Museum, covering archaeology, traditional and contemporary art.

items.title: The Big Review | Venice Biennale 2026: In Minor Keys
items.summary: 第61届威尼斯双年展主题展"In Minor Keys"评述。展览原由策展人Koyo Kouoh构思,她2025年离世后由五人团队完成,汇集约110位艺术家,分布中央馆与军械库两大场地,以"哨兵"人物串联历史创伤与超越等主题。评论给出三星半,认为中央馆布局节奏欠佳,军械库部分更具戏剧张力。

items.title_en: The Big Review | Venice Biennale 2026: In Minor Keys
items.summary_zh: 第61届威尼斯双年展主题展"In Minor Keys"评述。展览原由策展人Koyo Kouoh构思，她2025年离世后由五人团队完成，汇集约110位艺术家，分布中央馆与军械库两大场地，以"哨兵"人物串联历史创伤与超越等主题。评论给出三星半，认为中央馆布局节奏欠佳，军械库部分更具戏剧张力。
items.summary_en: A review of the 61st Venice Biennale's main exhibition "In Minor Keys". Originally conceived by curator Koyo Kouoh, who passed away in 2025, the exhibition was completed by a five-person team, featuring about 110 artists across the Central Pavilion and the Arsenale. It uses "sentry" figures to connect themes of historical trauma and transcendence. The review gives three and a half stars, noting that the Central Pavilion's layout lacks rhythm, while the Arsenale section has more dramatic tension.

Kang's immersive installation.

items.id: news-1arnoy-梦溪-主题展现古今对话-第61届威尼斯国际艺术双年展中国馆展览开幕
items.title: “梦溪”主题展现古今对话——第61届威尼斯国际艺术双年展中国馆展览开幕
items.summary: 第61届威尼斯国际艺术双年展中国馆5月8日在意大利开幕,主题"梦溪"取自北宋沈括《梦溪笔谈》,以"种子-光-共生"为脉络,呈现书法、影像、数字叙事等多种形式作品,含"致敬《梦溪笔谈》""良渚之光""逍遥游"等。展览由文化和旅游部主办,持续至11月22日。

items.title_en: "Dream Creek" Theme Showcases Dialogue Between Past and Present: China Pavilion Exhibition Opens at the 61st Venice International Art Biennale
items.summary_zh: 第61届威尼斯国际艺术双年展中国馆5月8日在意大利开幕，主题"梦溪"取自北宋沈括《梦溪笔谈》，以"种子-光-共生"为脉络，呈现书法、影像、数字叙事等多种形式作品，含"致敬《梦溪笔谈》""良渚之光""逍遥游"等。展览由文化和旅游部主办，持续至11月22日。
items.summary_en: The China Pavilion of the 61st Venice International Art Biennale opened on May 8 in Italy, with the theme "Dream Creek" taken from Shen Kuo's "Dream Pool Essays" of the Northern Song Dynasty. Following the thread of "Seed-Light-Symbiosis," it presents works in various forms including calligraphy, video, and digital narrative, featuring sections such as "Homage to Dream Pool Essays," "Light of Liangzhu," and "Wandering Beyond." The exhibition is hosted by the Ministry of Culture and Tourism and runs until November 22.

items.title: The 2026 Whitney Biennial in five key themes
items.summary: 文章梳理第82届惠特尼双年展的五大主题。展览无官方主题,56位艺术家及组合围绕"美国身份"与美国帝国影响展开,涉及物种间联系、复杂化历史(夏威夷殖民、菲律宾马科斯政权、艾滋病流行等)、城市与系统、观看与被观看、家庭事务。展览设于惠特尼美术馆五、六层。
items.title_zh: 2026年惠特尼双年展的五大主题
items.title_en: The 2026 Whitney Biennial in five key themes
items.summary_zh: 文章梳理第82届惠特尼双年展的五大主题。展览无官方主题，56位艺术家及组合围绕"美国身份"与美国帝国影响展开，涉及物种间联系、复杂化历史（夏威夷殖民、菲律宾马科斯政权、艾滋病流行等）、城市与系统、观看与被观看、家庭事务。展览设于惠特尼美术馆五、六层。
items.summary_en: The article outlines five key themes of the 82nd Whitney Biennial. The exhibition has no official theme; 56 artists and collectives explore "American identity" and the impact of the American empire, covering interspecies connections, complicating history (colonialism in Hawaii, Marcos regime in the Philippines, AIDS epidemic, etc.), cities and systems, looking and being looked at, and family matters. The exhibition is held on the fifth and sixth floors of the Whitney Museum.

items.id: news-1al93z-2026年-全球多场大展致敬艺术巨匠
items.title: 2026年,全球多场大展致敬艺术巨匠

items.title_en: 2026: Global Exhibitions Pay Tribute to Art Masters
items.summary_zh: 澎湃梳理2026年全球纪念艺术巨匠的重要展览：康斯特布尔250周年，泰特不列颠推出"透纳与康斯特布尔"，《干草车》首度回到故乡萨福克；布朗库西诞辰150周年，柏林新国家美术馆携手蓬皮杜办回顾展；另有莫德尔松-贝克150周年及伦敦国家肖像馆的玛丽莲·梦露百年肖像展等。
items.summary_en: The Paper reviews major global exhibitions in 2026 commemorating art masters: Constable's 250th anniversary, Tate Britain presents "Turner and Constable," with "The Hay Wain" returning to its native Suffolk for the first time; Brancusi's 150th birthday, a retrospective co-organized by the Neue Nationalgalerie Berlin and Centre Pompidou; also Modersohn-Becker's 150th anniversary and the National Portrait Gallery London's centenary portrait exhibition of Marilyn Monroe, among others.

items.title: Inside Refik Anadol's Dataland, the world's first AI art museum
items.summary: 《艺术新闻报》报道,艺术家Refik Anadol打造的'全球首座AI艺术博物馆'DATALAND于2026年6月20日在洛杉矶Grand LA开幕。观众佩戴监测心跳的腕带与释放香气的颈环;开幕展《Machine Dreams: Rainforest》用'大自然大模型'生成沉浸式雨林影像,并随观众反馈变化。
items.title_zh: 走进Refik Anadol的DATALAND：全球首座AI艺术博物馆
items.title_en: Inside Refik Anadol's Dataland, the world's first AI art museum
items.summary_zh: 《艺术新闻报》报道，艺术家Refik Anadol打造的'全球首座AI艺术博物馆'DATALAND于2026年6月20日在洛杉矶Grand LA开幕。观众佩戴监测心跳的腕带与释放香气的颈环；开幕展《Machine Dreams: Rainforest》用'大自然大模型'生成沉浸式雨林影像，并随观众反馈变化。
items.summary_en: The Art Newspaper reports that DATALAND, the 'world's first AI art museum' created by artist Refik Anadol, opened on June 20, 2026, at Grand LA in Los Angeles. Visitors wear wristbands that monitor heartbeats and necklaces that release scents; the opening exhibition "Machine Dreams: Rainforest" uses a 'large nature model' to generate immersive rainforest imagery that changes with audience feedback.

items.title: Avery Singer: War_overlays（苏黎世豪瑟沃斯个展）
items.source: Meer(艺术线上杂志) / Hauser & Wirth
items.summary: 艺术杂志Meer介绍Avery Singer在苏黎世豪瑟沃斯画廊的个展《War_overlays》(2026年6月12日-9月5日)。她首次将AI工具引入绘画,用ComfyUI训练定制LoRA生成'AI渣画质'图像;作品受鲍德里亚海湾战争论述启发,反思西方冲突如何作为媒体奇观被呈现。
items.title_zh: Avery Singer: War_overlays（苏黎世豪瑟沃斯个展）
items.title_en: Avery Singer: War_overlays (Hauser & Wirth Zurich solo exhibition)
items.summary_zh: 艺术杂志Meer介绍Avery Singer在苏黎世豪瑟沃斯画廊的个展《War_overlays》（2026年6月12日-9月5日）。她首次将AI工具引入绘画，用ComfyUI训练定制LoRA生成'AI渣画质'图像；作品受鲍德里亚海湾战争论述启发，反思西方冲突如何作为媒体奇观被呈现。
items.summary_en: Art magazine Meer introduces Avery Singer's solo exhibition "War_overlays" at Hauser & Wirth Zurich (June 12 - September 5, 2026). She introduces AI tools into painting for the first time, training custom LoRAs with ComfyUI to generate 'AI low-quality' images; the works are inspired by Baudrillard's discourse on the Gulf War, reflecting on how Western conflicts are presented as media spectacles.

items.title: Full Disclosure: The Edge of Information Design（信息设计的边缘）
items.source: MoMA 纽约现代艺术博物馆
items.summary: MoMA将于2026年9月27日至2027年6月推出首个专注信息设计的展览《Full Disclosure：信息设计的边缘》,展出30件数字与模拟作品(含六件新藏),涵盖'亲爱的数据''气候升温条纹'及法证建筑等,探讨人如何在日益复杂的数字世界中可视化并塑造对信息的理解。
items.title_zh: Full Disclosure: The Edge of Information Design（信息设计的边缘）
items.title_en: Full Disclosure: The Edge of Information Design
items.summary_zh: MoMA将于2026年9月27日至2027年6月推出首个专注信息设计的展览《Full Disclosure：信息设计的边缘》，展出30件数字与模拟作品（含六件新藏），涵盖'亲爱的数据''气候升温条纹'及法证建筑等，探讨人如何在日益复杂的数字世界中可视化并塑造对信息的理解。
items.summary_en: MoMA will present its first exhibition dedicated to information design, "Full Disclosure: The Edge of Information Design," from September 27, 2026 to June 2027, featuring 30 digital and analog works (including six new acquisitions), covering 'Dear Data,' 'Climate Warming Stripes,' and Forensic Architecture, exploring how people visualize and shape understanding of information in an increasingly complex digital world.

items.title: Before Friend.com, There Was Winkie: On Tech Hype in End Times
items.summary: 《艺术论坛》2026年夏季刊刊发Jonathan Odden的评论,以1984-85年洛杉矶'Winkie'电脑芯片营销闹剧为例,对照当下Friend.com等AI炒作,并分析Chip Lord等媒体艺术家1985年录像作品《Media Hostages》对科技景观的批判。
items.title_zh: 在Friend.com之前，有Winkie：论末日时代的科技炒作
items.title_en: Before Friend.com, There Was Winkie: On Tech Hype in End Times
items.summary_zh: 《艺术论坛》2026年夏季刊刊发Jonathan Odden的评论，以1984-85年洛杉矶'Winkie'电脑芯片营销闹剧为例，对照当下Friend.com等AI炒作，并分析Chip Lord等媒体艺术家1985年录像作品《Media Hostages》对科技景观的批判。
items.summary_en: Artforum's Summer 2026 issue features a review by Jonathan Odden, using the 1984-85 'Winkie' computer chip marketing fiasco in Los Angeles as an example, contrasting it with current AI hype like Friend.com, and analyzing media artists Chip Lord et al.'s 1985 video work "Media Hostages" as a critique of the tech landscape.

items.title: Cape Town Gallery Accused of Withholding Pay and Artworks
items.summary: 南非艺术家Kate Gottgens指控开普敦SMAC画廊扣留其画作并延迟付款，包括一幅作品在米兰艺博会后四年未归还。画廊否认指控，称延迟因进出口问题。Gottgens表示离开画廊后仍在争取归还作品，并已收到部分付款。
items.title_zh: 开普敦画廊被指控拖欠薪酬和扣留艺术品
items.title_en: Cape Town Gallery Accused of Withholding Pay and Artworks

items.summary_en: South African artist Kate Gottgens accuses Cape Town gallery SMAC of withholding her artworks and delaying payments, including a painting not returned for four years after a Milan fair. The gallery denies the claims, citing import/export issues. Gottgens says she is still struggling to recover works and has received some payments.

items.title: 庆祝50周年 德国路德维希博物馆举办盛大草间弥生展览
items.summary: 德国科隆路德维希博物馆为庆祝50周年，于3月14日起举办草间弥生展览，展期五个月，展出超过300件作品，包括新作《无限镜屋》及多件经典作品，追溯其80余年创作生涯。

items.summary_en: To celebrate its 50th anniversary, Museum Ludwig in Cologne, Germany, is hosting a Yayoi Kusama exhibition starting March 14, running for five months, featuring over 300 works including the new 'Infinity Mirror Room' and many classic pieces, tracing her over 80-year career.

items.summary: 瑞士巴塞尔贝耶勒基金会举办草间弥生首次大型回顾展，展出其七十年来的300件作品。文章探讨了草间弥生童年幻觉与心理创伤如何影响其艺术创作，以及她的自我营销与疗愈之间的张力。展览将持续至2026年1月25日。

items.summary_en: The Fondation Beyeler in Basel, Switzerland, is holding the first major retrospective of Yayoi Kusama, featuring 300 works from seven decades. The article explores how Kusama's childhood hallucinations and psychological trauma influence her art, and the tension between her self-marketing and healing. The exhibition runs until January 25, 2026.

items.title: 日本松本市美术馆 沉浸草间弥生的圆点幻境
items.summary: 文章介绍作者2024年5月参观日本松本市美术馆的经历，该馆长期展出草间弥生作品。馆外有装置艺术《幻之华》和外墙画作《松本から未来へ》，馆内展览分三部分：早期版画、镜屋和巨大南瓜作品，附诗作《辉煌之路》。圆点元素遍布馆内外。

items.summary_en: The article describes the author's visit to the Matsumoto City Museum of Art in May 2024, which permanently exhibits works by Yayoi Kusama. Outside are the installation 'The Visionary Flowers' and the mural 'To the Future, from Matsumoto'; inside, the exhibition is divided into three parts: early prints, a mirror room, and a giant pumpkin piece accompanied by the poem 'Resplendent Road'. Polka dots are everywhere.

items.title: 北京故宫 "展览：ICCF 与北京林琴学院和故宫博物院共同举办
items.summary: 意大利中国基金会（ICCF）与林琴学院和北京故宫博物院合作举办“北京故宫：来自紫禁城的历史镜头、艺术家和工匠”展览，展期为2026年5月4日至18日，展示根据中国古代传统技艺制作的工艺品，庆祝故宫博物院建院百年和中意建交55周年。
